correctness.rationale: The proof fixes the lattice and quantifiers, identifies the primitive cycle relation, computes the full lattice index of the non-semi-balanced simplex, obtains every fundamental-parallelepiped height, and uses standard circuit triangulations whose maximal cells are spanning-tree root simplices. The packaged verifier checks all orientations through cycle length eight using exact integer arithmetic and combinatorial h-polynomial reconstruction; the finite checks are explicitly not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Cycles are the minimal dependent graphs and a canonical test family for directed root-polytopes. The result supplies complete Ehrhart data where the foundational source only records a simplex/non-unimodularity observation, refines the later arbitrary-digraph degree theorem to every coefficient in this natural family, proves orientation-placement independence, and identifies the exact unimodularity boundary. This is a structural classification, not an arbitrary finite slice or table recomputation.
